Convert a logo to SVG

A clearer starting point for your logo

When the original vector file is missing, a raster logo can be traced into editable SVG shapes. ImageToVector gives you a quick starting point from a PNG or JPG logo.

Choose the cleanest, largest logo image available. Use a smaller color palette for simple marks, and check the generated edges and colors before using the file. This tool creates an automatic trace; it does not recreate your original source file or brand guidelines.

Open the free SVG tool ↗

Logo vectorization in three steps

Upload a logo image, adjust the palette and detail, then download the SVG. Flat colors and strong contrast usually give the clearest automatic trace. Transparent PNG backgrounds are retained.

Is the result a professional master logo?

An automatic trace is a useful starting point, not a guarantee of a production-ready brand asset. Inspect and edit the output in a vector editor for exact curves, colors, spacing, and brand standards.

Can I use the SVG on a website?

SVG is commonly used for scalable web graphics. Check the file in your site and design workflow, and optimize or edit it as needed.
